internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The consonantal skeleton ع-ذ-ب hosts two Quran-internally UNBRIDGED classes, not one nucleus. Class A (371/373): the punishment/torment family عَذَاب (noun, 322) + عَذَّبَ / يُعَذِّب (verb form II, 41) + مُعَذِّب/مُعَذَّب (participles form II, 8) = the infliction of intense, painful, humiliating suffering on a subject by an authority, characteristically punitive; welded by cognate-object syntax (عَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًا نُّكرًا, 65:8) and by systematic antonymy with mercy/forgiveness. Class B (2/373): عَذْب (fa'l noun/adjective, 25:53:6:1 & 35:12:5:1) = sweet, palatable fresh water, opposed to مِلْح أُجَاج (salty-bitter). The two share ONLY the radicals: different derivational pattern, zero shared collocate, zero co-occurrence, and OPPOSITE affective valence (painful vs. pleasant). No Quran-internal thread bridges them, so the honest root-level result is a partition, not a single meaning. Meaning is carried by the derivational form, not by the radicals.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Class A does NOT entail: (a) a divine agent — human agents inflict it: Dhu al-Qarnayn 18:86:19:1, Solomon threatening the hoopoe 27:21:1:2, Pharaoh forbidden 20:47:11:1, Pharaoh's people on the Israelites 2:49:8:2/7:141:8:2/14:6:16:2/7:167:12:2, Satan-attributed for Job 38:41:11:2; (b) eschatology — worldly عَذَاب occurs (العَذَابِ الأَدْنَىٰ 32:21:3:2, فِى الدُّنْيَا 9:55:9:2); (c) moral desert — the wronged Israelites and God's praised servant Job suffer it, so the root names the suffering, not its justice; (d) killing/annihilation — set as a distinct alternative to slaughter (27:21) and to destruction مُهلِك (17:58:11:1); (e) mercy/forgiveness/kind-treatment — always the opposed pole. The ROOT SKELETON ع-ذ-ب entails nothing semantically: Class B عَذْب is pleasant, the exact inverse pole, so no valence, no 'intensity', and no 'withholding' notion can be read into the bare radicals.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: هَٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ (25:53:6:1; and عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَآئِغٌ شَرَابُهُ 35:12:5:1) — 'sweet, fresh water, pleasant to drink,' explicitly paired against مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ. This single token is the exact affective inverse of painful عَذَاب and disproves ANY unified single-nucleus (or 'universal') reading of the root ع-ذ-ب: no account of 'infliction of painful suffering' can absorb 'delicious drinkable water,' and no morphological or collocational thread links the two anywhere in the 373 occurrences.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A monist unifier positing a maximally abstract nucleus — e.g. 'ع-ذ-ب = an intense sensory/affective experience at either extreme' (sweetness = peak palatability, torment = peak pain), or the classical derivation of عَذَاب from 'to withhold/prevent (منع)'. Rejected on Quran-internal grounds: (1) it would have to unite antonyms — عَذْب's actual in-text opposite مِلْح أُجَاج places it on the palatable pole, the antithesis of عَذَاب's pole, so the 'bridge' unifies a lexeme with the opposite of the other; (2) it is the vague catch-all the methodology forbids (fits everything, explains nothing, unfalsifiable); (3) the 'منع/withhold' etymology is a lexicon prior barred by source policy and is textually unsupported (عَذَاب is never said to 'prevent'; عَذْب water is فُرَات سَآئِغ, not 'thirst-preventing'). The data give no shared morphology, collocate, or scene across the classes.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B independent, C adversarial) converged on the SAME structural fact over full 373/373 coverage: a dominant, internally coherent punishment family (371) plus an isolated, semantically opposite عَذْب 'sweet water' class (2), with ZERO Quran-internal bridge. Per the contract's mandatory coherence rule — 'if two+ senses have no Quran-internal bridge (incl. homonyms), choose UNRESOLVED; do not force one nucleus' — the honest root-level verdict is UNRESOLVED / multi-class, NOT a forced abstraction. Taken in isolation Class A would grade STRONG (broad, distinctive, cognate-object-bound, mercy-antonym-anchored, adversarially clean, no internal resistant sub-class), and Class B is 2/2 internally consistent; but the resistant lexicalized nominal class عَذْب of opposite valence blocks any single root nucleus outright and caps a whole-root claim below STRONG. The result is therefore recorded as an unresolved partition into two lexemes carried by derivational form, with each class's account preserved at cluster level and the عَذْب pair marked as the persisted resistant seam.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form II verb عَذَّبَ/يُعَذِّب: an agent (God, or a human authority) causatively/transitively INFLICTS intense painful affliction on those under its power; set in explicit opposition to forgive/relent/show-mercy/kind-treatment.
clusters.classification_rationale: 41 occ, always causative-transitive with agent inflicting on object. Divine binary yaghfiru li-man yasha'u wa-yu'adhdhibu (2:284, 3:129, 5:18, 5:40, 48:14) and yu'adhdhibu man yasha'u wa-yarhamu (29:21). Human agents (18:86, 27:21, 20:47) fix the invariant as authority-inflicted affliction, not divinity per se. No occurrence resists.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Cognate-object binding to the noun (65:8:12:2 'adhdhabnaha 'adhaban nukran; 88:24:1:2) shows verb and noun are one event/lexeme.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form II participles: active مُعَذِّب 'one who inflicts torment' and passive مُعَذَّب 'the one tormented' — the two-place infliction relation (inflicter / sufferer).
clusters.classification_rationale: 8 occ split clean 4 active / 4 passive on the same nucleus. Active: 17:15, 17:58, 7:164, 8:33. Passive always in denial-of-affliction claims wa-ma nahnu bi-mu'adhdhabina (26:138, 26:213, 34:35, 37:59). Confirms 'adhab is a relation, not a substance.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 7:164:11:1 muhlikuhum aw mu'adhdhibuhum and 17:58:11:1 distinguish infliction of torment from destruction.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Noun عَذَاب: the intense, painful, humiliating affliction itself as an undergone experience — gradable in severity/duration (alim/'azim/shadid/muhin/muqim) and 'tasted' (dhuqu 'adhaba...); spans worldly penal and eschatological settings — one nucleus, two settings.
clusters.classification_rationale: 322 occ. Monovalent-painful qualifier profile; object of dhaqa and akhadha bi- (7:165:14:2). Adversarial boundaries tested and ABSORBED, not resistant: oppression of the innocent Israelites (2:49:8:2, 7:141:8:2, 14:6:16:2, 7:167:12:2) and Job's suffering (38:41:11:2) force the core down to bare 'inflicted painful affliction by a power' rather than 'deserved requital', but do not break the account. No occurrence in this class resists the affliction nucleus.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Antonymy with mercy/forgiveness is the strongest internal anchor; located in jahannam/al-nar/al-hariq and yawm al-qiyamah, and also an yusjana aw 'adhabun alim (12:25) for worldly judicial penalty.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: عَذْب (fa'l noun/adjective of water): sweet, fresh, palatable, pleasant-to-drink — the desirable pole, defined by antonymy with مِلْح أُجَاج and by سَآئِغٌ شَرَابُهُ.
clusters.classification_rationale: 2 occ, 2/2 internally consistent and identical frame (hadha 'adhbun furatun ...wa-hadha milhun ujaj). Marked RESISTANT at ROOT level: a lexicalized nominal/adjectival homonym of OPPOSITE valence with no Quran-internal bridge to Class A — it positively disconfirms any unified root nucleus. Internally, the sub-class is itself coherent; it resists only the demand for a single ع-ذ-ب meaning.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 25:53:6:1 and 35:12:5:1 never co-occur with, share no qualifier with, and trade no feature with any 'adhab occurrence.

adversarial_verification.notes: Root is unresolved-class-only: a whole-root falsification is NOT_REQUIRED because no single nucleus is claimed. The two classes are each internally coherent and mutually distinct (opposite valence, disjoint morphology and collocation), and the unification hypothesis was actively sought and refuted by the 'adhb pair rather than merely unrun.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B independent, C adversarial) over full 373/373 coverage converged on the identical two-class partition with zero Quran-internal bridge.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 373/373 occurrences read/sampled; qualifier profile, cognate-object syntax, active/passive participle split, and the 'adhb-milh ujaj contrast pair are all read directly from packet morphology and Tanzil verse_text.
layer_attribution.derivation: Meaning tracks derivational form: fa'l عَذْب (sweet) vs fa'al عَذَاب / fa''ala عَذَّبَ / participles مُعَذِّب-مُعَذَّب (torment). The bare radicals ع-ذ-ب carry no shared semantic content.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Two distinct lexemes under one consonantal skeleton: Class A punishment family (371, one tightly derivation-bound lexeme) and Class B عَذْب sweet-water (2). Homonymy, not polysemy — no demonstrable common nucleus.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Frames such as mercy/forgiveness antonymy, warning-conditioned divine infliction (17:15:18:1), and eschatological loci are CONTEXTUAL anchors that characterize Class A's usage; they are not elevated to the root claim, and no narrative gloss ('punishment of disbelievers') is treated as the root meaning.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: All three lenses independently produced the same partition and the same resistant seam; the aggregator adopts the contract-mandated UNRESOLVED verdict rather than the STRONG two-class structural framing that Lens B floated, because the payload's single root-claim slot cannot assert a nucleus where none is bridged.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The persisted resistant residue is exactly the عَذْب pair (25:53:6:1, 35:12:5:1): coherent in itself, opposite in valence, and unbridged to the torment family — the reason the root as a whole is UNRESOLVED rather than STRONG.

hard_cases.reason: 'adhbun furatun 'sweet fresh water', opposite valence to the torment family, sharing only the radicals; no Quran-internal bridge to Class A. It is the persisted resistant seam blocking any single root nucleus.

evidence_basis.statement: هَٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ (25:53:6:1) — the desirable, potable pole paired against مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ — is the exact affective inverse of painful عَذَاب and disproves any unified single-nucleus reading of ع-ذ-ب.

hard_cases.reason: 'adhbun furatun sa'ighun sharabuhu 'sweet fresh water, pleasant to drink' — second token of the resistant 'adhb class; no feature exchange with the torment family.

evidence_basis.statement: عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَآئِغٌ شَرَابُهُ (35:12:5:1) confirms عَذْب sits on the palatable pole opposite مِلْح أُجَاج, unbridged to عَذَاب.

hard_cases.reason: su'a al-'adhab inflicted by Pharaoh's people on the innocent Israelites: resists a 'deserved requital' sub-reading and forces Class A's core down to bare 'inflicted painful affliction by a power' — absorbed, not root-resistant.

evidence_basis.statement: The sufferers of su'a al-'adhab (2:49:8:2, 7:141:8:2, 14:6:16:2, 7:167:12:2) are the wronged, so Class A 'adhab names inflicted suffering, not its justice/desert.

hard_cases.reason: Job, God's praised servant, is touched by nusbin wa-'adhabin via Satan: resists both moral-desert and divine-agent narrowings of Class A — absorbed by the bare-affliction nucleus.

evidence_basis.statement: 38:41:11:2 shows 'adhab without moral desert and with a non-divine agent, confirming Class A does not entail requital or a divine inflicter.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The two عَذْب 'sweet water' occurrences are a genuine, lexicalized, opposite-valence class with no Quran-internal bridge to the torment family; they persist as resistant to any single-nucleus root account and are recorded as RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases plus counterevidence. Adversarial boundaries inside Class A (oppression of the innocent, Job) are recorded as absorbed boundaries, not root resistance.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal bridge is demonstrated connecting عَذْب 'sweet water' (25:53, 35:12) to the عَذَاب/'adhdhaba torment family, dissolving the two-class partition into a single demonstrable nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The عَذْب pair 25:53:6:1 and 35:12:5:1 compared against the 371 torment occurrences — checking specifically for any shared qualifier, co-occurrence, scene, or derivational contact.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test for a feature actually traded in the corpus: does any 'adhab token take furat/sa'igh or sit on the desirable pole, or does any 'adhb token take alim/shadid or an infliction frame; require an in-text link, not paraphrase.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude classical etymology and lexicon priors (e.g. ''adhb = withhold/mana') and any external synonym reasoning; a bridge counts only if built from in-corpus feature sharing between the actual occurrences.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a bridge is verified, the UNRESOLVED multi-class verdict is withdrawn and replaced by a single-nucleus ROOT_GENERALIZATION; if no bridge is found (current state), the partition and UNRESOLVED result stand.

reopen_conditions: If a further عَذْب (fa'l, buckwalter Ea*obN) occurrence appears beyond 25:53:6:1 and 35:12:5:1 and shares a qualifier, collocate, or scene with any عَذَاب/'adhdhaba torment occurrence, re-examine the homonymy partition for a possible bridge.
If any عَذَاب/yu'adhdhib occurrence is Quran-internally predicated of something desirable/potable (paired with furat/sa'igh rather than alim/shadid), reopen the painful-valence account of Class A.
If a 'adhab occurrence is found equated with, rather than opposed to, mercy/forgiveness (breaking the yaghfir/yu'adhdhib binary), reopen the affliction-vs-mercy anchor of Class A.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: Root is unresolved-class-only: a whole-root falsification is NOT_REQUIRED because no single nucleus is claimed. The two classes are each internally coherent and mutually distinct (opposite valence, disjoint morphology and collocation), and the unification hypothesis was actively sought and refuted by the 'adhb pair rather than merely unrun.
